blocks.text: Receptors ya sensors khaas banawat wale hisse hain (organs, tissues, cells ya cell ke andar ke hisse) jo andar ya bahar ke mahol mein tabdeeli ko pakarte (detect karte) hain. Yeh tabdeeli ki khabar control centre tak bhi pohanchate hain. Maslan jild (skin) ke receptor cells darja-e-hararat (temperature) ki tabdeeli pakarte hain. Isi tarah khoon ki nalyon (blood vessels) ke receptor cells blood pressure ki tabdeeli pakar kar control centre ko khabar dete hain.
